entry.title: UK government: Reduce cyber risk by modernising legacy IT
entry.summary:
Now that a new government is elected in the UK, we’re seeing increased focus on taxpayer value — as a key priority from both a spending and saving perspective. Based on the latest National Audit Office report, transforming legacy IT continues to be a priority for reducing operational vulnerability, enhancing integration with more data and services, and providing long-term savings by reducing maintenance costs and improving efficiency.
During my time working with numerous public sector departments, change like this is never simple, and the importance of ensuring that the people, processes, and technology evolve together requires careful planning and execution. Leading with this holistic approach is the best way to modernise legacy technology in order to reduce cyber risk at your organisation and ultimately free up time to focus on mission-driven government.
